preset.text:
If you run away, you cannot earn any items this round.
If you stay in the fight AND you get hit with at least one stoneball, you get injured and cannot earn any items this round.

The only way to earn items is to stay in the fight and hope that no stoneballs are coming your way. Be brave!

gameLoop.name: Remove snowballs thrown at people who left the fight

preset.text: If you're still in the fight, let's put you in the center!
The victors will take turns claiming the items in the center!
No need to click anything - the game will speed through this.
... the victors in the snowball fight will take turns clicking on items from the center to claim them, until all the items are gone.

Heal Once: remove one injury
Full Health: back to 0 injuries
Snow Queen: become the Snow Queen next round
Stoneball: get an extra stoneball!

Every round there is a Snow Queen card up for grabs.

Your name is color-coded according to your health. You start with full health (green).

After 1 injury, you become orange.
After 2 injuries, you become red.
After 3 injuries, you lose half your points and go back to green!
